description: React Native component for the Restaurant screen, displaying restaurant details, menu items, categories, search functionality, and cart interactions.

methods.name: wrapContentAfterWords
methods.description: Wraps content into lines with specified number of words per line.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Navigates to item detail screen, optionally clearing cart.

methods.name: tagCart
methods.description: Displays cart quantity tag for an item if present in cart.

methods.name: scrollElementById
methods.description: Scrolls to a specific category or subcategory section in the menu list.

methods.name: onPressItem
methods.description: Handles item press, checking availability and adding to cart.

methods.name: onViewableItemsChanged
methods.description: Updates selected category based on visible items.
